messages.content: Mazie has 52 marbles and gives them to twins, Dallas and Darla. 20 of the marbles owned by Mazie are blue. If Dallas has a total of 21 marbles after dropping 4 of them in the playground, how many did Mazie give to Darla?

content.text:
Mazie has 52 marbles total. Dallas has 21 marbles after losing 4, so he originally received 21 + 4 = 25 marbles.

Mazie gave Darla: 52 - 25 = **27 marbles**.
